summary.en: When Megure, Takagi, and Chiba arrived at Yoji Natsukawa's office, they meet Kogoro and Conan. Kogoro and Conan decide to assist them. The group then meet Yoji Natsukawa, Miyako Akiba, and Ryuzaburo Fuyuki. Natsukawa says that no one have a grudge against Haruyama, while both Akiba and Fuyuki don't know about Haruyama. The next day, Kogoro and Conan decide to question Natsukawa, but they found him dead instead. Natsukawa is also found dead in his office with the same method from the previous murder. After that, Akiba and Fuyuki admit that ten years ago, four of them cheated Takashi Komoto out of a large sum of money. Komoto then left Japan. One day, Haruyama saw Komoto peering into his shop. No one believed him until he was murdered. The police then found out that Komoto returned to Japan one week ago. They also found the hotel where he was staying and collect his fingerprints, confirming that he is the murderer. Komoto also revealed to a hotel employee that he has an incurable illness. The next day, Chiba accompanies Akiba to Shikigawa Valley. Suddenly, there is a loud noise, so Chiba goes check the noise. Not long after that, Komoto appears and attempts to stab Akiba. When Chiba goes to check the strange noise, Komoto appears and attemps to stab Akiba. Akiba manage to avoid the knife. Unfortunately, Komoto slips and fall down into the river. However, his body is never been found. He also hasn't show up at the hospital.
